notes:
Top-line: enterprise search vendor focused on global legal/content teams. Heavy multilingual needs (EN/FR/DE/ES/IT/JA/KO). Evaluating Redwood for embeddings + cross-lingual reranking to replace current brittle keyword stacks.

User comments / readouts: 
- "We need consistent recall across languages — FR/DE currently underperform versus EN" (Head of Search, 3/10 call).
- Interested in a hybrid approach: dense multilingual embeddings for retrieval + compact cross-encoder reranker per-language.
- Indexing scale: ~280M documents (legal docs + localized KBs), expect growth to 500M in 18 months.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile end-to-end < 400ms for search query (retrieval + rerank) for EU tenants; P50 < 150ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost/query < $0.02 for 90% of queries; willing to accept higher for complex cross-encoder rerank flows.
- Model preferences: open multilingual encoder (XLM-R / mUSE family) for embeddings; provision to run a distilled cross-encoder on dedicated GPUs for rerank. Quantization/INT8 recommended by infra team.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit trails, regional data residency in EU, BYOK KMS, and SOC2/ISO evidence.

Sales notes: POC scope = 6-week RAG pilot covering 3 languages (EN/FR/DE), 50M-doc sample indexing, baseline embedding set + cross-encoder reranker. Deliverables: per-language recall/precision at topK, latency/cost breakdown, tuning playbook for per-language thresholds.

Quote from CTO on 3/12: "If performance and privacy line up we can move to Dedicated pool + annual contract".

Internal: security questionnaire submitted (drive link), legal requested modified DPA (sent 3/14).
